stateNote: When the plate reaches temperature, ladle some batter on the plate. Quickly spread the batter across the plate with circling movements of a T-shaped batter spreader. Be careful not to rip or tear spots where the batter has already set—this takes a bit of practice. Never scrub over the surface—the move must come out of the wrist in a flowing movement, without holding the spreader too firmly.
